title: Quickstart
description: Health checks, then create, read, update and delete one document with @vellumdb/sdk-js.

title: Document CRUD & Optimistic Concurrency
description: create, get, set (merge and replace), update with ifVersion, delete, and a rejected stale write.

title: Atomic Field Transforms
description: increment, serverTimestamp, arrayUnion, arrayRemove and deleteField sentinels from fieldOp.

title: Structured Queries
description: where, orderBy, limit and select, including disjunctive in filters, via the query builder.

title: Cursor Pagination
description: Walk an ordered result set with opaque HMAC cursors using startAfter until nextCursor is null.

title: Composite Indexes
description: Create, list, query through and delete a tenant composite index using the REST API.

title: Realtime Snapshots
description: Subscribe to a document and a query with onSnapshot, make writes, observe callbacks, unsubscribe.

title: Batch Write
description: Mix create/set/update/delete in one atomic batch and observe precondition failure.

title: OCC Transactions
description: Commit a runTransaction and demonstrate both a forced conflict and a stale-version precondition.

title: Security Rules AST
description: Publish and inspect a versioned v1 rules AST over REST, reject an invalid AST, and restore state.

title: Errors & Limits
description: Trigger the canonical Vellum error codes for query complexity, quotas, conflicts and size limits.

title: Raw REST API
description: Use fetch directly for document CRUD, collection listing and structured query with x-project-key.

title: Authentication & API Keys
description: Email sign-in, session inspection, server API key lifecycle and expected 401 responses.
